bachelor planning

Business bachelor’s with an eligible ExcelTrack option

Compare competency-based business study with a conventional term route. A useful concentration and the required institutional block may matter more than purchasing every possible transfer.

What makes this route worth exploring

  • Competency-based terms where offered
  • Certificate award bundles
  • Quarter-credit accounting
  • Preserve useful institutional work

What needs to be confirmed

  • Verify exact current degree and ExcelTrack concentration availability.
  • Keep source semester units and actual destination quarter awards separate.
  • Historical recipe totals exceed its stated ceiling and are not a valid complete basket.
  • Confirm the capstone’s format and calendar duration.

Eligibility and your situation

  • Confirm ExcelTrack admission and self-directed-study readiness.
  • Program-specific transfer awards and current pricing remain to be established.

A practical sequence

  1. Choose exact degree, concentration, catalog and delivery model.
  2. Obtain evaluation with actual destination-unit awards.
  3. Allocate bundles once across core, major, electives and institutional rules.
  4. Resolve missing mappings and remove unsupported historical options.
  5. Schedule capstone and school assessments under current release rules.
  6. Finish degree audit and conferral.

Your next useful actions

  • Request prior-learning and ExcelTrack eligibility evaluations.
  • Ask which concentration and capstone work remains institutional.
  • Price the full remaining term sequence before buying certificates.

Ask for an individual evaluation.

Credit limits, degree placement, institutional-credit requirements, and professional eligibility are separate decisions. Use the current catalog and get the receiving school’s written confirmation.
